name: NexussREV Phase 5 static validation corpus
scope: Native PE32+ AMD64 static analysis and quality reporting. No input binary is executed.
method: Analyze SHA-256-pinned PE inputs as data; validate each report against the versioned schema; measure decode accounting, labelled boundaries, CFG edge integrity, unresolved facts, evidence provenance, signature/type metrics, reference differences, and artifact completeness.

phase2_build_provenance.stripping: For stripped variants, zero the PE export (data-directory 0) and debug/CodeView (data-directory 6) entries; executable bytes and exception/unwind metadata are retained.

provenance.license: Public domain; SQLite states that its deliverable code may be copied, modified, compiled, sold, and distributed for any purpose.
provenance.compiler_and_linker: Not identified on the official binary download page; intentionally recorded as unknown.
provenance.compiler_flags: Not published with this precompiled DLL; intentionally recorded as unknown.
provenance.static_analysis_policy: The PE is parsed as untrusted data and is never loaded or executed.

limitations: All accuracy claims are measured on the named, hash-identified corpus only; they do not generalize to arbitrary binaries or compiler families.
The SQLite DLL is a real-world public-domain PE, but its official download page does not publish its compiler identity or build flags; those fields remain explicitly unknown.
The SQLite DLL exceeds the analyzer's configured record budget; decode coverage and limit-excluded bytes are both reported rather than implying full disassembly.
The checked-in Clang/LLD fixtures are small original test programs. Existing Phase 2 and Phase 4 truth labels remain the only source-known boundary and signature/type samples.

The downloaded Antigravity-x64.exe is a 32-bit Nullsoft installer wrapper, outside the native PE32+ x86-64 application target; it is excluded and was not executed. No compatible Antigravity application binary was analyzed.
Dynamic execution, compile-and-test, and differential execution are not performed; all binaries and PDBs are handled as static data.
